provenance.final_labels: All 1000 records were approved in the local human review interface. The frozen CSV retains the saved decisions without relabeling or filtering at freeze time.
provenance.candidate_history: Prior human-unanimous, human-majority and AI-assisted adjudication provenance is retained in the CSV; the final reviewer confirmed every retained record.
provenance.selection: Post-hoc subset selected by original aspect agreement. It is not an unfiltered random evaluation sample.
provenance.agreement: Original pairwise agreement is computed from the three original annotators on the selected 1000 sentences (3000 pairs per field), not from the final adjudicated labels. Review completion is not inter-annotator agreement.
provenance.format: CSV with text and label as its first two columns; not the required eval.xls submission file.
provenance.revision_policy: Create a new version for any correction; do not overwrite this frozen CSV.
provenance.local_archive: Full raw snapshots, review event history and SQLite backup are retained locally and are not included in this GitHub publication.
provenance.publication_manifest: Repository-relative release metadata; this is not the byte-identical local freeze manifest, which contains machine-specific paths.
